comment:
* Helper for accessing {@link android.view.accessibility.AccessibilityWindowInfo}
 * introduced after API level 4 in a backwards compatible fashion.

variables.name: TYPE_APPLICATION
variables.comment:
* Window type: This is an application window. Such a window shows UI for
     * interacting with an application.

variables.name: TYPE_INPUT_METHOD
variables.comment:
* Window type: This is an input method window. Such a window shows UI for
     * inputting text such as keyboard, suggestions, etc.

variables.name: TYPE_SYSTEM
variables.comment:
* Window type: This is an system window. Such a window shows UI for
     * interacting with the system.

variables.name: TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY
variables.comment: * Window type: Windows that are overlaid only by an {@link * android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityService} for interception of * user interactions without changing the windows an accessibility service * can introspect. In particular, an accessibility service can introspect * only windows that a sighted user can interact with which they can touch * these windows or can type into these windows. For example, if there * is a full screen accessibility overlay that is touchable, the windows * below it will be introspectable by an accessibility service regardless * they are covered by a touchable window.

methods.name: static AccessibilityWindowInfoCompat wrapNonNullInstance(Object object)
methods.comment:
* Creates a wrapper for info implementation.
     *
     * @param object The info to wrap.
     * @return A wrapper for if the object is not null, null otherwise.

methods.name: public int getType()
methods.comment:
* Gets the type of the window.
     *
     * @return The type.
     *
     * @see #TYPE_APPLICATION
     * @see #TYPE_INPUT_METHOD
     * @see #TYPE_SYSTEM
     * @see #TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY

methods.name: public int getLayer()
methods.comment:
* Gets the layer which determines the Z-order of the window. Windows
     * with greater layer appear on top of windows with lesser layer.
     *
     * @return The window layer.

methods.name: public AccessibilityNodeInfoCompat getRoot()
methods.comment:
* Gets the root node in the window's hierarchy.
     *
     * @return The root node.

methods.name: public AccessibilityWindowInfoCompat getParent()
methods.comment:
* Gets the parent window if such.
     *
     * @return The parent window.

methods.name: public int getId()
methods.comment:
* Gets the unique window id.
     *
     * @return windowId The window id.

methods.name: public void getBoundsInScreen(Rect outBounds)
methods.comment:
* Gets the bounds of this window in the screen.
     *
     * @param outBounds The out window bounds.

methods.name: public boolean isActive()
methods.comment:
* Gets if this window is active. An active window is the one
     * the user is currently touching or the window has input focus
     * and the user is not touching any window.
     *
     * @return Whether this is the active window.

methods.name: public boolean isFocused()
methods.comment:
* Gets if this window has input focus.
     *
     * @return Whether has input focus.

methods.name: public boolean isAccessibilityFocused()
methods.comment:
* Gets if this window has accessibility focus.
     *
     * @return Whether has accessibility focus.

methods.name: public int getChildCount()
methods.comment:
* Gets the number of child windows.
     *
     * @return The child count.

methods.name: public AccessibilityWindowInfoCompat getChild(int index)
methods.comment:
* Gets the child window at a given index.
     *
     * @param index The index.
     * @return The child.

methods.name: public static AccessibilityWindowInfoCompat obtain()
methods.comment:
* Returns a cached instance if such is available or a new one is
     * created.
     *
     * @return An instance.

methods.name: public static AccessibilityWindowInfoCompat obtain(AccessibilityWindowInfoCompat info)
methods.comment: * Returns a cached instance if such is available or a new one is * created. The returned instance is initialized from the given * info. * * @param info The other info. * @return An instance.

methods.name: public void recycle()
methods.comment:
* Return an instance back to be reused. *

* Note: You must not touch the object after calling this function. *

* * @throws IllegalStateException If the info is already recycled.
